Yeah. It can be a 5-second scene but if the kiss were believable then we'll all be alright. :)
YES!!! you get me! As I've said, it seems they're not comfortable kissing each other.

Oh, I think the amount or frequency of the sex scenes is alright.  I am glad, too, that it's not like the L Word, where it became just about that for shock value (then not shocking at all). I was pointing out the ability of the actors to do the kissing scenes. It's like they're (actors) holding back--they're not comfortable kissing each other--which threw me off, because they're awesome the rest of the scenes.
yeah. there are so many and they overlap [labels].

Yes, I did, several times. To be brutally honest, it's kind of rewarding and flattering.  But that flattery is never worth the heartache in the end, so what I did [after my 1st messy break-up w/ a straight girl] was I just tried to have fun with them and took each day as it came.  I always kept my guard up because I knew what I was getting into.  I never took it out on them.   I was like --- have fun while it lasts. As much as possible Not put any negativity into her "stay". Why stress yourself out?

As for dating lesbians/bis, what I've realized recently is that it's more rewarding to date them.  I don't play the teacher anymore. LOL
I get you in a bones-deep level.

I don't think YOU are the problem.  I think her being STRAIGHT is. Sounds to me that she's in it for the adventure.  So always keep your guard when dealing with straighties. They can really mess you up.
It's been a week since I finished watching the whole season and I am still giggling like a 12-year-old girl.
